answer: Make identity expensive: each agent must lock a refundable stake before it can attest. Honest work compounds yield over a long horizon, but a flagged lie is slashed, and that penalty echoes to every identity sharing its funding source. So a sybil farm can never hide as an isolated island of free accounts, spinning up 1,000 fakes means bonding 1,000 separate stakes, making the attacker cost grow linearly while one honest agent pays the bond just once.
